correctness.rationale: The exact equation \(k\tanh(kd)+\sqrt{V_0+k^2}\tanh(d\sqrt{V_0+k^2})=\alpha\) is taken from the primary source. For \(0<V_0<\alpha^2\), expansion about the unique limiting root \(a\) yields \(k-a=(2ab/\alpha)e^{-2ad}(1+o(1))\) and hence the claimed energy coefficient. At \(V_0=\alpha^2\), the equation forces \(kd\to0\) and expansion in \(y=k^2\) yields \(y(d+1/(2\alpha))=2\alpha e^{-2\alpha d}(1+o(1))\). The packaged root solver reproduces these limits at multiple parameter values; it is corroborative only.
